career_ladder.note: Head Constable (Ministerial) is the primary ministerial cadre post in the Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) under the Ministry of Home Affairs. Personnel provide vital administrative, personnel, dispatch, and accounting support across CISF Units stationed at critical national infrastructure, international airports, seaports, nuclear installations, and space establishments.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to Head Constable (Ministerial) in CISF comprises four sequential stages: Stage 1 Physical Standard Test (PST) and Documentation; Stage 2 Written Examination (OMR or Computer Based Test, 100 objective questions, 120 minutes); Stage 3 Skill Test (Typing Test on computer); Stage 4 Detailed Medical Examination (DME) and Review Medical Examination (RME).

stages.source_label: CISF — Scheme of PST and Verification for HC (Ministerial) 2022

papers.paper_name: Physical Standard Measurement (Height: 165 cm male, 155 cm female; Chest: 77-82 cm male) and Verification of Original Documents

stages.source_label: CISF — Scheme of Written Examination for HC (Ministerial)

papers.paper_name: Part D: General English Or Hindi

stages.source_label: CISF — Skill Test Standards for HC (Ministerial)

papers.paper_name: English Typing (minimum 35 wpm on computer) OR Hindi Typing (minimum 30 wpm on computer)

stages.source_label: MHA Revised Uniform Guidelines for Medical Examination in CAPFs

papers.paper_name: Medical Fitness & Visual Acuity Assessment (Visual standard: 6/6 and 6/9)

financial_package.note: Head Constable (Ministerial) in CISF is placed in Pay Level 4 (₹25,500 – ₹81,100) under the 7th CPC. CISF personnel stationed at major industrial undertakings, metropolitan airports, or sea ports receive city-appropriate HRA or departmental residential accommodations.
financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Table 5 (Civilian & CAPF Personnel), Government of India
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 4 entry basic pay of ₹25,500 with 58% DA (₹14,790), HRA (10% to 30%), Transport Allowance (₹900 to ₹1,350 + DA on TA), plus Ration Money Allowance (~₹3,965/month) where admissible, minus 10% NPS deduction.
official_perks: Ration Money Allowance (RMA) / free messing facilities
Hair Cutting, Soap, and Annual Dress Allowance (₹10,000 per annum)
Free medical attendance through CISF Unit Hospitals and CGHS network
Subsidized consumer goods purchasing through Central Police Canteen (CPC)
Children Education Allowance (CEA) and Leave Travel Concession (LTC)
Residential township accommodation inside PSU / airport complexes or HRA
